directPaymentDiscovery.scope: Current operator-owned public charging infrastructure in Fürstenfeldbruck and the surrounding region
directPaymentDiscovery.note: The current 2026 operator tariff page explicitly separates card-contract pricing from simple ad-hoc charging by QR and credit card without a charging contract. The ad-hoc tariff is 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and 0.69 EUR/kWh DC.

ownershipAliasNote: The current charging operator is Ladelösungen Fürstenfeldbruck GmbH, presented by Stadtwerke Fürstenfeldbruck as its e-mobility subsidiary/operating company. Legacy FFBemobil/Stadtwerke Fürstenfeldbruck charging references are retained as aliases rather than counted as a second CPO.
reason: Current official operator page publishes exact 2026 direct-payment AC/DC prices and explicitly states QR plus credit-card access without contract binding.
